The '''Spyder''' was a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] [[Sabacc parlor/Legends|parlor]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was run by the reserved [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Korsin Fenn]]. It was frequented by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] operatives. At some point, the criminal [[Kaa'to Leeachos]] owed The Spyder 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and ended up banned from the place. The Spyder was important in a group of [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] operatives' mission to hunt down Leeachos, as they were able to pry information on him from Fenn and made contact wit some Black Sun members, from whom they managed to win information in a sabacc game.

==Behind the scenes==
The Spyder was introduced in the ''[[Under a Black Sun]]''-scenario. Gaining information on Leeachos from Fenn and winning information in a game of sabacc are presented as some of the options that the player characters can make use of in progressing through the scenario.
